messages:
tess: FYI bringing ember-lite-v1 to staging. did a quick onboarding eval focusing on recall@k + clustering for short/mid queries. odd numeric pattern, posting results and quick hypotheses. :mag_right:
omar: paste numbers pls
tess: short table from a 1k holdout (stratified len buckets):
```
model: ember-lite-v1
dataset: holdout_1k_stratified
metric: recall@1,5,10 | silhouette (per-bucket)
fp16:  <=5  r@1 0.68 r@5 0.88 r@10 0.92  sil 0.24
        6-15 r@1 0.72 r@5 0.90 r@10 0.93  sil 0.27
int8:   <=5  r@1 0.65 r@5 0.81 r@10 0.86  sil 0.10
        6-15 r@1 0.54 r@5 0.76 r@10 0.82  sil 0.08
notes: int8 hit both short and mid but mid bucket collapse is surprising
```
jing: mid collapse looks similar to quant-induced norm shrink + cross-bucket negative mixing. did you use mean-centering before knn?
tess: used straight cosine on raw vectors. mean_norm fp16=1.14, int8=0.94. i ran a tiny whitening fit on fp16 ref and applied to int8 -> mid bucket r@1 improved from 0.54 -> 0.62, silhouette +0.09.
lucas: interesting. can you share eval command and quant config?
tess: `python eval/recall.py --model ember-lite-v1 --dataset holdout_1k_stratified --quant int8 --calib_samples 2048 --knn_metric cosine --neg 64`
quant config: per-tensor int8 symmetric clamp, no per-channel scales yet
eval-bot: eval-ci | run 1845678901 | status: completed | artifacts: s3://redwood/eval/1845678901/mats.tar.gz
omar: try per-channel + lang/len stratified calib samples. also test dot-product knn (after length-norm) to see if metric flips gap.
jing: i'll spin up a matrix: per-channel vs per-tensor, calib sizes [512,2k,8k], metric [cosine,dot], preprocessing [raw,mean-center+norm,whitening(fp16-ref)]. will stream results.
lucas: also check negatives: current negatives are random across corpus; mid-length queries often have near neighbors of similar length. add hard-neg sampling by length and by token-overlap.
tess: plan actions: 1) per-channel calib sweep (jing) 2) hard-neg experiment (omar) 3) micro-diff activations for a handful of mid queries to see rounding hotspots (lucas). I'll collect UMAPs + silhouette tables and open ticket ENG-2022 with links.
deploy-bot: staging-deploy | ember-lite-v1 -> deployed to staging pool gpu-c1 (id: stg-501) :rocket:
ejing: started sweep, will post matrix link.
omar: noted, tagging owners @jing @lucas. thanks! :white_check_mark:
